svg.text: CASES-99 hockey stick from the GABLS2 LES (48×48×80), nights 18-06 LT, 5-min tower segments

(a, b) solid: bin means of V_TKE = √e (resolved + SGS) per tower level; dashed: the fitted two-segment line. (c) circles: Sun et al. (2012) Fig. 3a (digitised), dashed: its log fit; squares: fitted V_s.
